youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用逛舊貨市場情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從進市場淘舊貨問價、檢查品相砍價、聊復古收藏談成小單，到打包付款與攤主閒聊收攤折扣，400句一次聽好。不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Flea Market phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue), covering the whole market day: browsing stalls and asking prices, checking condition and bargaining, chatting about vintage finds and closing a small deal, then packing, paying and late-hour discounts. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you know where the flea market is?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju noʊ wɛr ðə fleɪ ˈmɑrkɪt ɪz/
dialogue.zh: 你知道舊貨市場在哪裡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just turn left by the old bridge.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst tɜrn lɛft baɪ ði oʊld brɪdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 沿著舊橋左轉就到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow, there are so many stalls today!
dialogue.phonetic: /waʊ ðɛr ɑr soʊ ˈmɛni stɔlz təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 哇，今天攤位也太多了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Weekends are always the busiest here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwikˌɛndz ɑr ˈɔlˌweɪz ðə ˈbɪziɪst hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 這裡週末向來最熱鬧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What time does this market open?
dialogue.phonetic: /wət taɪm dʌz ðɪs ˈmɑrkɪt ˈoʊpən/
dialogue.zh: 這個市場幾點開始？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Vendors start setting up at six.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈvɛndərz stɑrt ˈsɛtɪŋ ʌp æt sɪks/
dialogue.zh: 攤販六點就來擺攤了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is everything on this table for sale?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ ɑn ðɪs ˈteɪbəl fər seɪl/
dialogue.zh: 這桌上所有東西都賣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, all of it came from my attic.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɔl ʌv ɪt keɪm frʌm maɪ ˈætɪk/
dialogue.zh: 是啊，全是我從閣樓搬來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much is this small brass lamp?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ ɪz ðɪs smɔl bræs læmp/
dialogue.zh: 這盞小黃銅燈多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That one is twenty-five dollars.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʌn ɪz ˈtwɛnti faɪv ˈdɑlərz/
dialogue.zh: 那盞二十五塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do these plates come as a set?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ðiz pleɪts kʌm æz ɛ sɛt/
dialogue.zh: 這些盤子是一整套嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six plates, but two are missing.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks pleɪts bʌt tu ɑr ˈmɪsɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 六個盤子，不過缺了兩個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You know, I collect old dishes like these.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju noʊ aɪ kəˈlɛkt oʊld ˈdɪʃɪz laɪk ðiz/
dialogue.zh: 說實話，我專收這類舊餐具。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the blue cups are a steal.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðə blu kʌps ɑr ə stil/
dialogue.zh: 那這些藍杯子你賺到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are these cups sold separately?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ðiz kʌps soʊld ˈsɛpərətli/
dialogue.zh: 這些杯子可以單賣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, one cup is three dollars.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr wʌn kʌp ɪz θri ˈdɑlərz/
dialogue.zh: 可以，一個杯子三塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The two blue ones look great on my shelf.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə tu blu wʌnz lʊk ɡreɪt ɑn maɪ ʃɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 那兩個藍杯子擺在我架上正好看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good choice, they clean up nicely.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd tʃɔɪs ðeɪ klin ʌp ˈnaɪsli/
dialogue.zh: 選得好，擦乾淨更好看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where did you find this wooden box?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr dɪd ju faɪnd ðɪs ˈwʊdən bɑks/
dialogue.zh: 這個木箱你哪兒找來的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: An estate sale across town last month.
dialogue.phonetic: /æn ɛˈsteɪl seɪl əˈkrɔs taʊn læst mʌnθ/
dialogue.zh: 上個月城那頭的遺產拍賣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the little key still work?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə ˈlɪtəl ki stɪl wɜrk/
dialogue.zh: 這把小鑰匙還管用嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sadly, the key went missing years ago.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsædli ðə ki wɛnt ˈmɪsɪŋ jɪrz əˈɡoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 可惜，鑰匙好幾年前就不見了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any old books in that stack?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛni oʊld bʊks ɪn ðæt stæk/
dialogue.zh: 那疊裡有舊書嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mostly cookbooks and old comics.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmoʊstli ˈkʊkˌbʊks ænd oʊld ˈkɑmɪks/
dialogue.zh: 多是食譜和舊連環畫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much for this stack of records?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ fər ðɪs stæk ʌv ˈrɛkərdz/
dialogue.zh: 這一疊唱片怎麼賣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One dollar each, or five for ten.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈdɑlər itʃ ɔr faɪv fər tɛn/
dialogue.zh: 一張一塊，十塊拿五張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I flip through these pages?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ flɪp θru ðiz ˈpeɪdʒɪz/
dialogue.zh: 我能翻翻書頁嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, just be gentle please.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔrs dʒʌst bi ˈdʒɛntəl pliz/
dialogue.zh: 當然，請輕一點翻。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This cover has a nice design.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈkʌvər hæz ə naɪs dɪˈzaɪn/
dialogue.zh: 這封面設計真好看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That artist was famous in the sixties.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈɑrtɪst wʌz ˈfeɪməs ɪn ðə ˈsɪkstiz/
dialogue.zh: 那位畫家六十年代很有名。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this metal pot heavy or light?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɪs ˈmɛtəl pɑt ˈhɛvi ɔr laɪt/
dialogue.zh: 這口金屬鍋是沉是輕？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Feel it, solid copper and quite heavy.
dialogue.phonetic: /fil ɪt ˈsɑlɪd ˈkɑpər ænd kwaɪt ˈhɛvi/
dialogue.zh: 你掂掂，純銅的，挺沉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you sell these by the piece?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju sɛl ðiz baɪ ðə pis/
dialogue.zh: 這些是一片一片賣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the price depends on the size.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə praɪs dɪˈpɛndz ɑn ðə saɪz/
dialogue.zh: 對，看多大來定價。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is in the green glass jar?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪz ɪn ðə ɡrin ɡlæs dʒɑr/
dialogue.zh: 那個綠玻璃罐裡是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Old buttons my grandmother kept.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊld ˈbɑtənz maɪ ˈɡrænˌmʌðər kɛpt/
dialogue.zh: 我奶奶留下的舊鈕扣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These buttons are so colorful!
dialogue.phonetic: /ðiz ˈbɑtənz ɑr soʊ ˈkʌlɚfəl/
dialogue.zh: 這些鈕扣好鮮豔！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: People buy them for craft projects.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpipəl baɪ ðɛm fər kræft ˈprɑdʒɛkts/
dialogue.zh: 常有人買了去做手工。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much is the whole jar?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ ɪz ðə hoʊl dʒɑr/
dialogue.zh: 整罐多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For you, eight dollars.
dialogue.phonetic: /fər ju eɪt ˈdɑlərz/
dialogue.zh: 給你算八塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have anything bigger?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju hæv ˈɛniˌθɪŋ ˈbɪɡɚ/
dialogue.zh: 有沒有更大件的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The trunk behind me is much larger.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə trʌŋk bɪˈhaɪnd mi ɪz mʌtʃ ˈlɑrdʒɚ/
dialogue.zh: 我身後那口木箱大得多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I move this blanket to look?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ muv ðɪs ˈblæŋkɪt tə lʊk/
dialogue.zh: 我把毯子挪開看看好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go ahead, but it is very heavy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡoʊ əˈhɛd bʌt ɪt ɪz ˈvɛri ˈhɛvi/
dialogue.zh: 請便，那個很重喔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Someone left stickers on this trunk.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌmˌwʌn lɛft ˈstɪkərz ɑn ðɪs trʌŋk/
dialogue.zh: 這箱子上有人貼了貼紙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I like them, they look original.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ laɪk ðɛm ðeɪ lʊk əˈrɪdʒɪnəl/
dialogue.zh: 我倒喜歡，看起來是原樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hold on, is this market only on Sundays?
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ɑn ɪz ðɪs ˈmɑrkɪt ˈoʊnli ɑn ˈsʌnˌdeɪz/
dialogue.zh: 對了，這市場只有星期日開嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Saturdays and Sundays, rain or shine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsætərˌdeɪz ænd ˈsʌnˌdeɪz reɪn ɔr ʃaɪn/
dialogue.zh: 週六週日都開，風雨無阻。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The lamp over there still works?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə læmp ˈoʊvər ðɛr stɪl wɜrks/
dialogue.zh: 那邊那盞燈還能亮嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The bulb is gone, but the base is lovely.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bʌlb ɪz ɡɑn bʌt ðə beɪs ɪz ˈlʌvli/
dialogue.zh: 燈泡沒了，燈座倒是漂亮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do the other vendors know each other?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ði ˈʌðər ˈvɛndərz noʊ itʃ ˈʌðər/
dialogue.zh: 其他攤販彼此都認識嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most of us have been here for years.
dialogue.phonetic: /moʊst ʌv ʌs hæv bɪn hɪr fər jɪrz/
dialogue.zh: 我們多數人來好幾年了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, may I ask your name?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ meɪ aɪ æsk jɔr neɪm/
dialogue.zh: 對了，請問我該怎麼稱呼你？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Everyone here calls me Rosa.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvriˌwʌn hɪr kɔlz mi ˈroʊzə/
dialogue.zh: 大夥都叫我羅莎。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice to meet you, Rosa.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs tə mit ju ˈroʊzə/
dialogue.zh: 很高興認識你，羅莎。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice to meet you too, friend.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs tə mit ju tu frɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 我也高興認識你，朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you set this table yourself?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju sɛt ðɪs ˈteɪbəl jɔːrˈsɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 這攤位是你自己擺的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I plan it early every morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs aɪ plæn ɪt ˈɜrli ˈɛvri ˈmɔrnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 是啊，我每天早上很早起來整理。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that folding chair still safe?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt ˈfoʊldɪŋ tʃɛr stɪl seɪf/
dialogue.zh: 那把折疊椅還穩嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try it, it holds my whole weight.
dialogue.phonetic: /traɪ ɪt ɪt hoʊldz maɪ hoʊl weɪt/
dialogue.zh: 你坐坐，我坐上去都不塌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, I came here for a round mirror.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl aɪ keɪm hɪr fər ə raʊnd ˈmɪrər/
dialogue.zh: 是這樣的，我是來找一面圓鏡子的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right over there, on the second shelf.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ˈoʊvɚ ðɛr ɑn ðə ˈsɛkənd ʃɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 就在那邊，第二層架子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The frame has some paint on it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə freɪm hæz sʌm peɪnt ɑn ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 鏡框上沾了些油漆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That old paint adds character, I think.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt oʊld peɪnt ædz ˈkɛrəktər aɪ θɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 我覺得舊漆反而更有味道。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: On top of that, I need a small rug.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn tɑp ʌv ðæt aɪ nid ə smɑl rʌɡ/
dialogue.zh: 除此之外，我還想添一塊小地毯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The rolled ones are near the back wall.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə roʊld wʌnz ɑr nɪr ðə bæk wɔl/
dialogue.zh: 捲起來的都放在後牆那邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you take cards or only cash?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju teɪk kɑrdz ɔr ˈoʊnli kæʃ/
dialogue.zh: 你收卡還是只收現金？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cash only, there is an ATM outside.
dialogue.phonetic: /kæʃ ˈoʊnli ðɛr ɪz æn eɪˌtiˈɛm ˌaʊtˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 只收現金，外頭有提款機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good news, I have some change with me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd nuz aɪ hæv sʌm tʃeɪndʒ wɪθ mi/
dialogue.zh: 好消息，我身上帶著零錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, small bills help me a lot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt smɔl bɪlz hɛlp mi ɛ lɑt/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，小鈔幫大忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the market crowded in the afternoon?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈmɑrkɪt ˈkraʊdɪd ɪn ði ˌæftərˈnun/
dialogue.zh: 下午市場會不會很擠？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Around noon the walkways get tight.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈraʊnd nun ðə ˈwɔkˌweɪz ɡɛt taɪt/
dialogue.zh: 一到正午，走道就擠不過了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are these sunglasses real or props?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ðiz ˈsʌnˌɡlæsɪz ril ɔr prɑps/
dialogue.zh: 這些太陽眼鏡是真的還是擺設？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Real ones, with unscratched lenses.
dialogue.phonetic: /ril wʌnz wɪθ ˈʌnˌskrætʃt ˈlɛnsɪz/
dialogue.zh: 真的，鏡片也沒有刮痕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hey, a dog is sleeping under your stall.
dialogue.phonetic: /heɪ ə dɑɡ ɪz ˈslipɪŋ ˈʌndər jɔr stɔl/
dialogue.zh: 你看，有隻狗睡在你攤子底下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is Biscuit, our market mascot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ˈbɪskɪt ˈaʊər ˈmɑrkɪt ˈmæskɑt/
dialogue.zh: 那是餅乾，是我們市場的吉祥物。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I pet him while I browse?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ aɪ pɛt hɪm waɪl aɪ braʊz/
dialogue.zh: 我逛的時候能摸摸牠嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He loves attention, please do.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi lʌvz əˈtɛnʃən pliz du/
dialogue.zh: 牠最愛人理，儘管摸。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the prices on paper reliable?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ðə ˈpraɪsɪz ɑn ˈpeɪpər rɪˈlaɪəbl/
dialogue.zh: 紙上寫的價靠得住嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, my son typed all the signs.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs maɪ sʌn ˈtaɪpt ɔl ðə saɪnz/
dialogue.zh: 靠得住，牌子都是我兒子打的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Those signs make shopping easier.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðoʊz saɪnz meɪk ˈʃɑpɪŋ ˈizɪɚ/
dialogue.zh: 有那些牌子，逛起來輕鬆多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I used to shout prices at everyone.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ jʊzd tə ʃaʊt ˈpraɪsɪz æt ˈɛvriˌwʌn/
dialogue.zh: 以前我總得挨個喊價。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did that couple buy the blue radio?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ðæt ˈkʌpəl baɪ ðə blu ˈreɪˌdioʊ/
dialogue.zh: 剛才那對夫妻買了藍收音機嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, they went home to think more.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ðeɪ wɛnt hoʊm tə θɪŋk mɔr/
dialogue.zh: 沒有，他們說回去再想想。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Old radios are hard to find now.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊld ˈreɪˌdioʊz ɑr hɑrd tə faɪnd naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 老收音機現在很難找了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This one still picks up stations.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs wʌn stɪl pɪks ʌp ˈsteɪʃənz/
dialogue.zh: 這台還收得到台。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the volume knob turn smoothly?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə ˈvɑljum nɑb tɜrn ˈsmuðli/
dialogue.zh: 音量旋鈕轉起來順嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little stiff, but it works.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɛ ˈlɪtəl stɪf bʌt ɪt wɜrks/
dialogue.zh: 有點緊，不過能用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is the best price here?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪz ðə bɛst praɪs hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 這裡最優惠的價是多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Best price depends on what you buy.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɛst praɪs dɪˈpɛndz ɑn wət ju baɪ/
dialogue.zh: 優惠要看你拿幾樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe I will take the radio too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi aɪ wɪl teɪk ðə ˈreɪˌdioʊ tu/
dialogue.zh: 說不定收音機我也一起帶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we can talk numbers.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi kæn tɔk ˈnʌmbərz/
dialogue.zh: 那咱們就能好好談價。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The walkway smells like coffee and dust.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈwɔkˌweɪ smɛlz laɪk ˈkɔfi ænd dʌst/
dialogue.zh: 走道上又是咖啡又是灰塵味。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The coffee cart sits at the main gate.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈkɔfi kɑrt sɪts æt ðə meɪn ɡeɪt/
dialogue.zh: 咖啡車就停在大門口。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I need water more than coffee.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ nid ˈwɔtər mɔr ðæn ˈkɔfi/
dialogue.zh: 我更想喝水，不想喝咖啡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is a machine by the restrooms.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə məˈʃin baɪ ðə ˈrɛstˌrumz/
dialogue.zh: 洗手間旁邊有自動販賣機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you, you have been so helpful.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju ju hæv bɪn soʊ ˈhɛlpfəl/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你，你可幫了大忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anytime, browsing is my favorite part.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛnɪˌtaɪm ˈbraʊzɪŋ ɪz maɪ ˈfeɪvərɪt pɑrt/
dialogue.zh: 不客氣，看攤是我最愛的一環。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me write down what I want.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi raɪt daʊn wət aɪ wɑnt/
dialogue.zh: 我先把想買的寫下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No hurry, the items are not going anywhere.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈhɜri ði ˈaɪtəmz ɑr nɑt ˈɡoʊɪŋ ˈɛnɪˌwɛr/
dialogue.zh: 別著急，東西又跑不掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I pick up this ceramic bowl?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ pɪk ʌp ðɪ səˈræmɪk boʊl/
dialogue.zh: 我能拿這個瓷碗看看嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold it by the rim, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ɪt baɪ ðə rɪm pliz/
dialogue.zh: 請扶著碗邊拿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a crack under the glaze?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ə kræk ˈʌndər ðə ɡleɪz/
dialogue.zh: 釉面下面有裂紋嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Shine your phone light on the inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃaɪn jɔːr foʊn laɪt ɑn ði ˈɪnˌsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 用手機燈照照裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, one tiny chip sits near the foot.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk wʌn ˈtaɪni tʃɪp sɪts nɪr ðə fʊt/
dialogue.zh: 瞧，底腳那兒有個小缺角。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That chip was there when I bought it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt tʃɪp wʌz ðɛr wɛn aɪ bɔt ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我買進時那個缺就有了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would the price change with that flaw?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊd ðə praɪs tʃeɪndʒ wɪð ðæt flɔ/
dialogue.zh: 有那個瑕疵，價會變嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can drop three dollars for it.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kæn drɑp θri ˈdɑlərz fər ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 為這個我可以少算三塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The handle feels loose on this cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈhændəl filz lus ɑn ðɪs kʌp/
dialogue.zh: 這杯子的把手摸著鬆了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Glue it and it will hold fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡlu ɪt ænd ɪt wɪl hoʊld faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 黏一下就穩了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you sell glue at this stall?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju sɛl ɡlu æt ðɪs stɔl/
dialogue.zh: 你這攤賣膠水嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, but the next row sells hardware.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ bʌt ðə nɛkst roʊ sɛlz ˈhɑrdˌwɛr/
dialogue.zh: 不賣，不過下一排有五金。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This drawer sticks when I pull it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs drɔr stɪks wɛn aɪ pʊl ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 這抽屜一拉就卡住。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Old wood swells in summer rain.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊld wʊd swɛlz ɪn ˈsʌmər reɪn/
dialogue.zh: 老木頭遇到夏天的雨會膨脹。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the key turn without forcing?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə ki tɜrn wɪˈðaʊt ˈfɔrsɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 鑰匙不用硬扳也轉得動嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Jiggle it gently and it opens.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdʒɪɡəl ɪt ˈdʒɛntli ænd ɪt ˈoʊpənz/
dialogue.zh: 輕輕晃一下就開了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The mirror has spots along the edge.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈmɪrər hæz spɑts əˈlɔŋ ði ɛdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 鏡子邊緣有一片片斑點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Those are age spots, very common.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðoʊz ɑr eɪdʒ spɑts ˈvɛri ˈkɑmən/
dialogue.zh: 那是氧化斑，很常見。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will those spots spread more later?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ðoʊz spɑts sprɛd mɔr ˈleɪtər/
dialogue.zh: 這些斑點以後會擴大嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep it dry and it stays put.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ɪt draɪ ænd ɪt steɪz pʊt/
dialogue.zh: 保持乾燥就不會再蔓延。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The lamp shade has a small tear.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə læmp ʃeɪd hæz ə smɔl tɪr/
dialogue.zh: 燈罩上有一道小破口。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I have a plain shade you can have free.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hæv ə pleɪn ʃeɪd ju kæn hæv fri/
dialogue.zh: 我這有素色燈罩，白送你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Really? That solves my problem.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrɪli ðæt sɑlvz maɪ ˈprɑbləm/
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？那我問題解決了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is not pretty, but it fits.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz nɑt ˈprɪti bʌt ɪt fɪts/
dialogue.zh: 不太好看，不過尺寸剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we talk about the price?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi tɔk əˈbaʊt ðə praɪs/
dialogue.zh: 我們可以聊聊價錢嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, what number do you have?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr wʌt ˈnʌmbər du ju hæv/
dialogue.zh: 好啊，你心裡是多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would you take fifteen for this box?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊd ju teɪk ˈfɪfˌtin fər ðɪs bɑks/
dialogue.zh: 這盒子十五賣不賣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fifteen is a little low for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɪfˌtin ɪz ə ˈlɪtəl loʊ fər mi/
dialogue.zh: 十五對我來說有點低。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Actually, I saw a similar one for twelve.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈæktʃuəli aɪ sɔ ə ˈsɪmələr wʌn fər twɛlv/
dialogue.zh: 老實說，我在別處見過相似的賣十二。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then check if theirs keeps the original lock.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn tʃɛk ɪf ðɛrz kɪps ði əˈrɪdʒɪnəl lɑk/
dialogue.zh: 那你確認下那家有原裝鎖嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this lock still the original one?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɪs lɑk stɪl ði əˈrɪdʒɪnəl wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 這鎖還是原本那個嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, nothing on it was ever replaced.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈnʌθɪŋ ɑn ɪt wʌz ˈɛvər rɪˈpleɪst/
dialogue.zh: 對，上面沒換過任何零件。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, that is worth more then.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ðæt ɪz wɜrθ mɔr ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 好吧，那這就值錢些了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will meet you at eighteen.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl mit ju æt ˈeɪˌtin/
dialogue.zh: 我讓到十八給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Make it sixteen and we are done.
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪk ɪt ˈsɪksˌtin ænd wi ɑr dʌn/
dialogue.zh: 十六，咱們就算成交。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sixteen is fine, you drive hard.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪksˌtin ɪz faɪn ju draɪv hɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 十六可以，你真會殺價。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, I like a good haggle too.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl aɪ laɪk ə ɡʊd ˈhæɡəl tu/
dialogue.zh: 說真的，我也享受痛快砍價。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You asked nicely, so I said yes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju æskt ˈnaɪsli soʊ aɪ sɛd jɛs/
dialogue.zh: 你問得客氣，我就答應了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this rug hand woven or machine made?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɪs rʌɡ hænd ˈwoʊvən ɔr məˈʃin meɪd/
dialogue.zh: 這地毯是手工還機器織的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hand woven, look at the uneven fringe.
dialogue.phonetic: /hænd ˈwoʊvən lʊk æt ði ʌnˈivən frɪndʒ/
dialogue.zh: 手工的，看這不齊的流蘇。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The colors on this rug are still bright.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈkʌlərz ɑn ðɪs rʌɡ ɑr stɪl braɪt/
dialogue.zh: 這地毯的顏色還很鮮豔。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sun fades wool, so it lived indoors.
dialogue.phonetic: /sʌn feɪdz wʊl soʊ ɪt lɪvd ɪnˈdɔrz/
dialogue.zh: 太陽會曬褪羊毛，所以它一直待在屋裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are there holes along the binding?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ðɛr hoʊlz əˈlɔŋ ðə ˈbaɪndɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 滾邊那一圈有破洞嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One small hole, I mended it already.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn smɔl hoʊl aɪ ˈmɛndɪd ɪt ɔlˈrɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 一個小洞，我已經補好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I roll it out to see?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ roʊl ɪt aʊt tə si/
dialogue.zh: 我能攤開來看看嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, mind the table behind you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔrs maɪnd ðə ˈteɪbəl bɪˈhaɪnd ju/
dialogue.zh: 當然，留意你身後的桌子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This part of the pattern is rubbed.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs pɑrt ʌv ðə ˈpætərn ɪz rʌbd/
dialogue.zh: 這塊花紋已經磨平了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rubbed spots are cheaper, so I marked it down.
dialogue.phonetic: /rʌbd spɑts ɑr ˈtʃipər soʊ aɪ mɑrkt ɪt daʊn/
dialogue.zh: 磨損的就便宜賣，所以我降了價。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much cheaper can it get?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ ˈtʃipər kæn ɪt ɡɛt/
dialogue.zh: 還能再便宜多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty off if you carry it away now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti ɔf ɪf ju ˈkæri ɪt əˈweɪ naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 你現在就搬走，我少算二十。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No car today, I walked here instead.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ kɑr təˈdeɪ aɪ wɔkt hɪr ɪnˈstɛd/
dialogue.zh: 我今天沒開車，是走路過來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is a cart near the entrance.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə kɑrt nɪr ði ˈɛntrəns/
dialogue.zh: 入口那邊有手推車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does that cart cost anything to use?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðæt kɑrt kɔst ˈɛniˌθɪŋ tə juz/
dialogue.zh: 那推車用起來要錢嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just a quarter, and you get it back.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ə ˈkwɔrtər ænd ju ɡɛt ɪt bæk/
dialogue.zh: 只收二毛五，還退給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lucky for me, a quarter is in my bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlʌkɪ fər mi ə ˈkwɔrtər ɪz ɪn maɪ bæɡ/
dialogue.zh: 算我運氣好，那枚二十五分的硬幣就在包裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then you are all set for the rug.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ju ɑr ɔl sɛt fər ðə rʌɡ/
dialogue.zh: 那你搬地毯就沒問題了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The clock hands do not match.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə klɑk hændz du nɑt mætʃ/
dialogue.zh: 這鐘的兩根指針不配。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Someone swapped them, the old ones are lost.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌmˌwʌn swɑpt ðɛm ði oʊld wʌnz ɑr lɔst/
dialogue.zh: 讓人換過了，原有的不見了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I open the back of the clock?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ ˈoʊpən ðə bæk ʌv ðə klɑk/
dialogue.zh: 我能打開鐘的背板嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, two screws, I have a screwdriver.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs tu skruz aɪ hæv ə ˈskruˌdaɪvər/
dialogue.zh: 可以，兩顆螺絲，我有起子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The inside looks surprisingly clean.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈɪnˌsaɪd lʊks sərˈpraɪzɪŋli klin/
dialogue.zh: 裡面乾淨得讓人意外。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I cleaned it myself just last week.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈklind ɪt maɪˈsɛlf dʒʌst læst wik/
dialogue.zh: 上週我才自己清理過。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does it keep good time?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ɪt kip ɡʊd taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 它走得準不準？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It runs fast by two minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt rʌnz fæst baɪ tu ˈmɪnɪts/
dialogue.zh: 它每天快兩分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two minutes I can live with.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈmɪnɪts aɪ kæn lɪv wɪð/
dialogue.zh: 快兩分鐘我還能忍。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then tell me your honest number.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn tɛl mi jɔːr ˈɑnɪst ˈnʌmbər/
dialogue.zh: 那你報個誠實的價。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Forty dollars, that is my top offer.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɔrti ˈdɑlərz ðæt ɪz maɪ tɑp ˈɔfər/
dialogue.zh: 四十塊，這是我的最高價。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is that truly top, or five more?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt ˈtruɪ tɑp ɔr faɪv mɔr/
dialogue.zh: 真是最高嗎？不能再加五塊？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Forty-five, and you wrap it for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɔrti faɪv ænd ju ræp ɪt fər mi/
dialogue.zh: 四十五，你得幫我包好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Deal, wrapping is my favorite job.
dialogue.phonetic: /dil ˈræpɪŋ ɪz maɪ ˈfeɪvərɪt dʒɑb/
dialogue.zh: 成交，包東西是我最愛的活。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Before paying, I want to check that chair.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪˈfɔr ˈpeɪɪŋ aɪ wɑnt tə tʃɛk ðæt tʃɛr/
dialogue.zh: 付錢之前，那把椅子我還想檢查一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sit down and lean back slowly.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪt daʊn ænd lin bæk ˈsloʊli/
dialogue.zh: 坐下，慢慢往後靠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The seat cushion is flat, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə sit ˈkʊʃən ɪz flæt ˈɑnɪstli/
dialogue.zh: 老實說坐墊都壓扁了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Add a folded towel and it feels new.
dialogue.phonetic: /æd ə ˈfoʊldɪd ˈtaʊəl ænd ɪt filz nju/
dialogue.zh: 墊條摺好的毛巾就跟新的一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the wood strong under the paint?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə wʊd strɔŋ ˈʌndər ðə peɪnt/
dialogue.zh: 油漆底下的木頭結實嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tap it and listen for a solid sound.
dialogue.phonetic: /tæp ɪt ænd ˈlɪsən fər ə ˈsɑlɪd saʊnd/
dialogue.zh: 敲敲看，聽那結實的聲音。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This sounds solid to my ear.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs aʊndz ˈsɑlɪd tə maɪ ɪr/
dialogue.zh: 我聽著挺結實的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then it can hold a grown person.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ɪt kæn hoʊld ə ɡroʊn ˈpɜrsən/
dialogue.zh: 那撐得住一個大人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any scratches on the arm rests?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛni ˈskrætʃɪz ɑn ði ɑrm rɛsts/
dialogue.zh: 扶手上有刮痕嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two light ones, right where your elbow rests.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu laɪt wʌnz raɪt wɛr jɔːr ˈɛlˌboʊ rɛsts/
dialogue.zh: 兩道淺的，正好在你手肘那。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I see the bottom of the frame?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ si ðə ˈbɑtəm ʌv ðə freɪm/
dialogue.zh: 我能看看椅架底部嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lay it flat, do not drag the legs.
dialogue.phonetic: /leɪ ɪt flæt du nɑt dræɡ ðə lɛɡz/
dialogue.zh: 放平，別拖著椅腳走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No rot here, that is lucky.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ rɑt hɪr ðæt ɪz ˈlʌki/
dialogue.zh: 這兒沒腐爛，真運氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rot is the worst thing in old furniture.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɑt ɪz ðə wɜrst θɪŋ ɪn oʊld ˈfɜrnɪtʃər/
dialogue.zh: 老傢俱最怕的就是爛木頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much for the chair with the rug?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ fər ðə tʃɛr wɪð ðə rʌɡ/
dialogue.zh: 椅子和地毯一起多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Together sixty-five, and the towel is free.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈɡɛðər ˈsɪksti faɪv ænd ðə ˈtaʊəl ɪz fri/
dialogue.zh: 一共六十五，毛巾再送你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sixty sounds closer to fair.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪksti aʊndz ˈkloʊsər tə fɛr/
dialogue.zh: 六十這個數聽著公道多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fair for both of us, I hope.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛr fər boʊθ ʌv ʌs aɪ hoʊp/
dialogue.zh: 但願對咱們兩個都公道。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please put a hold on those two.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz pʊt ə hoʊld ɑn ðoʊz tu/
dialogue.zh: 請先幫我把這兩樣留著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will tag them with your name.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl tæɡ ðɛm wɪθ jɔːr neɪm/
dialogue.zh: 我在上面寫你的名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more thing, this glass vase.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr θɪŋ ðɪs ɡlæs veɪs/
dialogue.zh: 還有一樣，這個玻璃花瓶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The vase has a bubble inside the glass.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə veɪs hæz ə ˈbʌbəl ɪnˈsaɪd ðə ɡlæs/
dialogue.zh: 花瓶玻璃裡裹著一個氣泡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that bubble a flaw or a feature?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt ˈbʌbəl ə flɔ ɔr ə ˈfitʃər/
dialogue.zh: 那氣泡算缺點還是特色？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Handmade glass always has one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌhændˈmeɪd ɡlæs ˈɔlˌweɪz hæz wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 手工吹的玻璃總有一個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I will pay full price for it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ wɪl peɪ fʊl praɪs fər ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那這個我按原價買。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is kind, since vases sell slowly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz kaɪnd sɪns ˈveɪsɪz sɛl ˈsloʊli/
dialogue.zh: 你真好，花瓶一向賣得慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bargains do not last long here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɑrɡənz du nɑt læst lɔŋ hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 便宜貨在這裡留不長。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: True, quick buyers get the best finds.
dialogue.phonetic: /tru kwɪk ˈbaɪərz ɡɛt ðə bɛst faɪndz/
dialogue.zh: 是啊，手快才撿得到寶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: All settled, I am ready to buy now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl ˈsɛtld aɪ æm ˈrɛdi tə baɪ naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 都決定好了，我現在準備開買。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, let me find a bigger bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt lɛt mi faɪnd ə ˈbɪɡər bæɡ/
dialogue.zh: 好，我找個更大的袋子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Secretly, I collect vintage postcards.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪkrətli aɪ kəˈlɛkt ˈvɪntɪdʒ ˈpoʊstˌkɑrdz/
dialogue.zh: 說出來怕你笑，我其實收藏老明信片。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This tin holds hundreds, help yourself.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs tɪn hoʊldz ˈhʌndrədz hɛlp jɔːrˈsɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 這鐵盒有幾百張，自己挑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are these sorted by city already?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ðiz ˈsɔrtɪd baɪ ˈsɪti ɔlˈrɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 這些已經按城市分了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Coastal cities are in the left row.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkoʊstəl ˈsɪtiz ɑr ɪn ðə lɛft roʊ/
dialogue.zh: 沿海城市的都在左邊那排。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This one shows the pier years ago.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs wʌn ʃoʊz ðə pɪr jɪrz əˈɡoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 這張拍的是多年前的棧橋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That pier burned down in the seventies.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt pɪr bɜrnd daʊn ɪn ðə ˈsɛvəntiz/
dialogue.zh: 那座棧橋七○年代燒掉了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So this card is all we have left.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðɪs kɑrd ɪz ɔl wi hæv lɛft/
dialogue.zh: 那這張就成了僅存的紀念。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, that is why I price it fairly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli ðæt ɪz waɪ aɪ praɪs ɪt ˈfɛrli/
dialogue.zh: 就是這道理，所以我定價很公道。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you know who drew this one?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju noʊ hu dru ðɪs wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 你知道這張是誰畫的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The initials in the corner read Hana.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ɪˈnɪʃəlz ɪn ðə ˈkɔrnər rid ˈhænə/
dialogue.zh: 角落的簽名縮寫是 Hana。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Gee, I have seen that name somewhere.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒi aɪ hæv sɪn ðæt neɪm ˈsʌmˌwɛr/
dialogue.zh: 咦，這名字我在哪兒見過。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Collectors hunt her colored sketches.
dialogue.phonetic: /kəˈlɛktərz hʌnt hɜr ˈkʌlərd ˈskɛtʃɪz/
dialogue.zh: 收藏家四處找她的彩繪。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much for these ten postcards?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ fər ðiz tɛn ˈpoʊstˌkɑrdz/
dialogue.zh: 這十張明信片多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One dollar each, you chose common ones.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈdɑlər itʃ ju tʃoz ˈkɑmən wʌnz/
dialogue.zh: 一張一塊，你挑的都是常見的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about the sealed envelope at the back?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt əˈbaʊt ðə sild ˈɑnvəˌloʊp æt ðə bæk/
dialogue.zh: 後面那個封好的信封呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Unopened mail from an old house.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌʌnˈoʊpənd meɪl frʌm ən oʊld haʊs/
dialogue.zh: 從老房子裡翻出的未開封信。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are there letters inside it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ðɛr ˈlɛtərz ɪnˈsaɪd ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 裡面真有信嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nobody knows, and that is the fun.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnoʊbəˌdi noʊz ænd ðæt ɪz ðə fʌn/
dialogue.zh: 沒人知道，這就是趣味。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: For the mystery alone, I will buy it.
dialogue.phonetic: /fər ðə ˈmɪstəri əˈloʊn aɪ wɪl ˈbaɪ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 光為這份神祕，也值得買了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three dollars, and good luck reading.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri ˈdɑlərz ænd ɡʊd lʊk ˈridɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 三塊，祝你讀得順利。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that an old film camera?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt ən oʊld fɪlm ˈkæmərə/
dialogue.zh: 那是老式底片相機嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A brownie box, my father kept it dry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈbraʊni bɑks maɪ ˈfɑðər kɛpt ɪt draɪ/
dialogue.zh: 盒式相機，我爸收得很乾燥。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the shutter still click shut?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə ˈʃʌtər stɪl klɪk ʃʌt/
dialogue.zh: 快門還按得下去嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Listen, that is a clean click.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɪsən ðæt ɪz ə klɪn klɪk/
dialogue.zh: 你聽，這聲響多乾脆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The lens has a little haze.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə lɛnz hæz ə ˈlɪtəl heɪz/
dialogue.zh: 鏡片有點發霧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Haze is common for cameras this old.
dialogue.phonetic: /heɪz ɪz ˈkɑmən fər ˈkæmərəz ðɪs oʊld/
dialogue.zh: 這麼老的相機有霧很正常。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would it still take a decent photo?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊd ɪt stɪl teɪk ə ˈdisənt ˈfoʊtoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 它還拍得出像樣的照片嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Film fans call that haze a soft look.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɪlm fænz kɔl ðæt heɪz ə sɔft lʊk/
dialogue.zh: 玩底片的人管這叫柔和感。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Of course, it needs the right film first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔrs ɪt nidz ðə raɪt fɪlm fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 話雖如此，它還得先配上對的底片。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The camera shop two blocks east has it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈkæmərə ʃɑp tu blɑks ist hæz ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 東邊兩條街的相機行有。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have the leather case too?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju hæv ðə ˈlɛðər keɪs tu/
dialogue.zh: 配套的皮套你有嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The case is cracked but still closes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə keɪs ɪz krækt bʌt stɪl ˈkloʊzɪz/
dialogue.zh: 皮套裂了，不過還扣得上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Camera plus case, what is your price?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkæmərə plʌs keɪs wʌt ɪz jɔːr praɪs/
dialogue.zh: 相機加皮套，你開多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Apart they are fifty, together forty.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈpɑrt ðeɪ ɑr ˈfɪfti təˈɡɛðər ˈfɔrti/
dialogue.zh: 分開算五十，一起四十。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could the case count as free?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd ðə keɪs kaʊnt æz fri/
dialogue.zh: 皮套能不能算送的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are good at this bargaining game.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɑr ɡʊd æt ðɪs ˈbɑrɡənɪŋ ɡeɪm/
dialogue.zh: 你可真會砍價。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thirty-five, and I take both now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɜrti faɪv ænd aɪ teɪk boʊθ naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 三十五，兩樣我現在就帶走。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Make it thirty-eight and it is yours.
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪk ɪt ˈθɜrti eɪt ænd ɪt ɪz jɔrz/
dialogue.zh: 三十八成交，它就歸你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thirty-eight, done and dusted.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɜrti eɪt dʌn ænd ˈdʌstɪd/
dialogue.zh: 三十八，說定不改了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I like selling to someone who cares.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ laɪk ˈsɛlɪŋ tə ˈsʌmˌwʌn hu kɛrz/
dialogue.zh: 我情願賣給懂得珍惜的人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My shelf at home is all vintage.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ʃɛlf æt hoʊm ɪz ɔl ˈvɪntɪdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 我家那層架清一色老東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do you display them or actually use them?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju dɪˈspleɪ ðɛm ɔr ˈæktʃuəli juz ðɛm/
dialogue.zh: 你是擺著還是真的用？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Honestly, I use the mugs and wear the watches.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɑnəstli aɪ juz ðə mʌɡz ænd wɛr ðə ˈwɑtʃɪz/
dialogue.zh: 說真的，杯子我用，表我也戴。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then you keep old things alive.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ju kip oʊld θɪŋz əˈlaɪv/
dialogue.zh: 那你是讓舊物繼續活著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have any old wristwatches?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju hæv ˈɛni oʊld ˈrɪstˌwætʃɪz/
dialogue.zh: 你有舊手錶嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two in the tray, neither one runs.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ɪn ðə treɪ ˈnaɪðər wʌn rʌnz/
dialogue.zh: 托盤裡兩隻，都不走了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Broken watches still look handsome.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbroʊkən ˈwɑtʃɪz stɪl lʊk ˈhænsəm/
dialogue.zh: 壞表看著也體面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A watchmaker can fix them cheaply.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈwɑtʃˌmeɪkɚ kæn fɪks ðɛm ˈtʃipli/
dialogue.zh: 表匠修一下花不了多少。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, I will take the silver dial one.
dialogue.phonetic: /həm aɪ wɪl teɪk ðə ˈsɪlvəl ˈdaɪəl wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我要那隻銀色表盤的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That one has a scratched back plate.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʌn hæz ə skrætʃt bæk pleɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那隻背面有刮痕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Scratches do not bother me at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈskrætʃɪz du nɑt ˈbɑðər mi æt ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 刮痕我一點也不在意。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then eight dollars, and no taking it back.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn eɪt ˈdɑlərz ænd noʊ ˈteɪkɪŋ ɪt bæk/
dialogue.zh: 那就八塊，售出不退。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These brooches are such tiny jewels.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðiz ˈbroʊtʃɪz ɑr sʌtʃ ˈtaɪni ˈdʒuələz/
dialogue.zh: 這些胸針像一顆顆小首飾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The flower one carries a real pearl.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈflaʊər wʌn ˈkæriəz ə ril pɜrl/
dialogue.zh: 那朵花上鑲的是真珍珠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the pin still sharp enough?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə pɪn stɪl ʃɑrp ɪˈnʌf/
dialogue.zh: 別針還夠尖嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Test it on this scrap of cloth.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛst ɪt ɑn ðɪs skræp əv klɔθ/
dialogue.zh: 在這塊碎布上試試。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It goes through easily, good.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt goʊz θru ˈizəli ɡʊd/
dialogue.zh: 一下就穿過去了，不錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rusty pins will stain your jacket.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrʌsti pɪnz wɪl steɪn jɔːr ˈdʒækɪt/
dialogue.zh: 生鏽的別針會弄髒外衣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any vinyl records from the sixties?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛni ˈvaɪnəl ˈrɛkərdz frʌm ðə ˈsɪkstiz/
dialogue.zh: 有六十年代的黑膠嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The crate by the wall has many.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kreɪt baɪ ðə wɔl hæz ˈmɛni/
dialogue.zh: 牆邊那木箱裡多的是。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are these sleeves original or replaced?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ðiz slivz əˈrɪdʒɪnəl ɔr rɪˈpleɪst/
dialogue.zh: 這些封套是原件還是換過的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mostly replaced, but the record matters more.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmoʊstli rɪˈpleɪst bʌt ðə ˈrɛkərd ˈmætərz mɔr/
dialogue.zh: 多是換的，唱片本身才要緊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The paper on this record is torn.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈpeɪpər ɑn ðɪs ˈrɛkərd ɪz tɔrn/
dialogue.zh: 這張唱片的紙套破了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tape it gently and it will last.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪp ɪt ˈdʒɛntli ænd ɪt wɪl læst/
dialogue.zh: 輕輕貼一下就又撐得住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the vinyl itself free of scratches?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈvaɪnəl itsɛlf fri əv ˈskrætʃɪz/
dialogue.zh: 唱片本身沒有刮痕吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold it sideways under the lamp.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ɪt ˈsaɪdweɪz ˈʌndər ðə læmp/
dialogue.zh: 側起來對著燈看看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here it is, one long hairline mark.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɪt ɪz wʌn lɔŋ ˈhɛərˌlaɪn mɑrk/
dialogue.zh: 看到了，有一道長長的細痕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hairlines only tickle, they do not skip.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhɛərˌlaɪnz ˈoʊnli ˈtɪkəl ðeɪ du nɑt skɪp/
dialogue.zh: 細痕只有一點沙沙聲，不會跳針。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I hear it on your player?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ hɪr ɪt ɑn jɔːr ˈpleɪər/
dialogue.zh: 能在你那唱機上聽一首嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, drop the needle and sit down.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs drɑp ðə ˈnidəl ænd sɪt daʊn/
dialogue.zh: 行，你把唱針放下去坐好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The sound is warm and quiet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə saʊnd ɪz wɔrm ænd ˈkwaɪət/
dialogue.zh: 這聲音又暖又乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Old pressings often beat new ones.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊld ˈprɛsɪŋz ˈɔfən bit nju wʌnz/
dialogue.zh: 老壓的唱片常勝過新的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, this record and that one will come home.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðɪs ˈrɛkərd ænd ðæt wʌn wɪl kəm hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 那好，這張和那張都跟我回家。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both together are nine dollars.
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ təˈɡɛðər ɑr naɪn ˈdɑlərz/
dialogue.zh: 兩張一共九塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do these brass keys open anything?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ðiz bræs kiz ˈoʊpən ˈɛniˌθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 這串黃銅鑰匙開得了什麼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: None, they are only lovely to hold.
dialogue.phonetic: /nʌn ðeɪ ɑr ˈoʊnli ˈlʌvli tə hoʊld/
dialogue.zh: 一個也開不了，光拿著就好看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: At home, old keys hang right by my door.
dialogue.phonetic: /æt hoʊm oʊld kiz hæŋ raɪt baɪ maɪ dɔr/
dialogue.zh: 在我家，舊鑰匙就掛在門邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then this bunch is yours for six.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðɪs bʌntʃ ɪz jɔrz fər sɪks/
dialogue.zh: 那這一大串六塊給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you ever get matching sets?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju ˈɛvər ɡɛt ˈmætʃɪŋ sɛts/
dialogue.zh: 你偶爾會收到成套的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rarely, most sellers break sets apart.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrɛrli moʊst ˈsɛləz breɪk sɛts əˈpɑrt/
dialogue.zh: 少見，多數人都把成套拆開賣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which item is your favorite here?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ ˈaɪtəm ɪz jɔːr ˈfeɪvərɪt hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 這攤你最喜歡哪一件？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The green inkwell, my grandfather wrote letters.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ɡrin ˈɪŋkˌwɛl maɪ ˈɡrænˌfɑðər roʊt ˈlɛtərz/
dialogue.zh: 那個綠墨水瓶，我爺爺寫信用的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would you part with the inkwell?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊd ju pɑrt wɪð ði ˈɪŋkˌwɛl/
dialogue.zh: 那墨水瓶你捨得賣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only to someone who will fill it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli tə ˈsʌmˌwʊn hu wɪl fil ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 只賣給會真的用它的人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Each week, a real letter goes out from me.
dialogue.phonetic: /itʃ wik ə ril ˈlɛtər ɡoʊz aʊt frʌm mi/
dialogue.zh: 我每週都會親筆寄出一封信。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then it belongs with you, take it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ɪt bɪˈlɔŋz wɪθ ju teɪk ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那它該跟著你，拿去吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I cannot take it for free.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈkɑnɑt teɪk ɪt fər fri/
dialogue.zh: 我不能白拿你的東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give me ten and we both smile.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɪv mi tɛn ænd wi boʊθ smaɪl/
dialogue.zh: 給我十塊，咱倆都開心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You are making my morning better.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɑr ˈmeɪkɪŋ maɪ ˈmɔrnɪŋ ˈbɛtər/
dialogue.zh: 你讓我這一早上都開心起來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is what a market should do.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz wʌt ə ˈmɑrkɪt ʃʊd du/
dialogue.zh: 市場本來就該是這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay then, let me gather everything I chose.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ðɛn lɛt mi ˈɡæðər ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ aɪ tʃoz/
dialogue.zh: 好，那我先把挑中的東西都收攏過來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will stack it on that side table.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl stæk ɪt ɑn ðæt saɪd ˈteɪbəl/
dialogue.zh: 我幫你堆到旁邊那張桌上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four small bags is a lot to carry.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr smɔl bæɡz ɪz ə lɑt tə ˈkæri/
dialogue.zh: 四個小袋子抱著太多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use my crate wheels, they roll fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz maɪ kreɪt wilz ðeɪ roʊl faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 用我那帶輪的箱子，推著很順。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You think of everything, Rosa.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju θɪŋk ʌv ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ ˈroʊzə/
dialogue.zh: 你什麼都替人想到，羅莎。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty years of market lessons help.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti jɪrz ʌv ˈmɑrkɪt ˈlɛsənz hɛlp/
dialogue.zh: 擺攤二十年，學乖了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did I leave anything on your table?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd aɪ liv ˈɛniˌθɪŋ ɑn jɔːr ˈteɪbəl/
dialogue.zh: 我有沒有東西落在你攤上？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just your list, folded by the cash box.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst jɔːr lɪst ˈfoʊldɪd baɪ ðə kæʃ bɑks/
dialogue.zh: 就你那張清單，擱在錢箱邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, that list is my treasure map.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ðæt lɪst ɪz maɪ ˈtrɛʃər mæp/
dialogue.zh: 正好，那是我挖寶的地圖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Next week bring the map back early.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst wik brɪŋ ðə mæp bæk ˈɜrli/
dialogue.zh: 下週拿地圖早點來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you help me pack all this?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju hɛlp mi pæk ɔl ðɪs/
dialogue.zh: 能幫我把它們包起來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, the rug rolls around everything.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr ðə rʌɡ roʊlz əˈraʊnd ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 行啊，用地毯把東西捲進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will that keep the vase safe?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ðæt kip ðə veɪs seɪf/
dialogue.zh: 那樣花瓶就安全了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will wrap it in newspaper first.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl ræp ɪt ɪn ˈnuzˌpeɪpər fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 我先拿報紙替它裹一層。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have tape I can borrow?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju hæv teɪp aɪ kæn ˈbɑˌroʊ/
dialogue.zh: 有膠帶能借我用一下嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, but my scissors stay with me.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɛr bʌt maɪ ˈsɪdərz steɪ wɪθ mi/
dialogue.zh: 給，不過剪刀我得留在手邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The camera goes on top, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈkæmərə ɡoʊz ɑn tɑp raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 相機要放最上面，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, never under anything heavy.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈnɛvər ˈʌndər ˈɛniˌθɪŋ ˈhɛvi/
dialogue.zh: 對，千萬別讓重物壓著它。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here, there is string in my jacket pocket.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ðɛr ɪz strɪŋ ɪn maɪ ˈdʒækɪt ˈpɑkɪt/
dialogue.zh: 給，我外套口袋裡正好有細繩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, tie it twice around the crate.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt taɪ ɪt twaɪz əˈraʊnd ðə kreɪt/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，箱子繞兩道繫緊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this bag strong enough for the box?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɪs bæɡ strɔŋ ɪˈnʌf fər ðə bɑks/
dialogue.zh: 這袋子夠結實，裝那木箱沒問題吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use two bags, the wood really weighs.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz tu bæɡz ðə wʊd ˈrɪli weɪz/
dialogue.zh: 套兩層吧，那木頭是真沉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, let us see the final number.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ lɛt ʌs si ðə ˈfaɪnəl ˈnʌmbər/
dialogue.zh: 好，咱們看看最後的數目。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me add it up slowly.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi æd ɪt ʌp ˈsloʊli/
dialogue.zh: 我慢慢替你算一遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No rush, the math can wait a minute.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ rʌʃ ðə mæθ kæn weɪt ə ˈmɪnɪt/
dialogue.zh: 不急，帳晚一點再算也行。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That comes to two hundred twenty-two dollars.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt kʌmz tə tu ˈhʌndrəd ˈtwɛnti tu ˈdɑlərz/
dialogue.zh: 總共二百二十二塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two hundred twenty-two? That feels high.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈhʌndrəd ˈtwɛnti tu ðæt filz haɪ/
dialogue.zh: 二百二十二？這有點高吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait, I counted the rug twice.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt aɪ ˈkaʊntɪd ðə rʌɡ twaɪz/
dialogue.zh: 等等，地毯被我算兩次了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So the real total is lower?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðə ril ˈtoʊtəl ɪz ˈloʊər/
dialogue.zh: 那實際總數更低囉？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two hundred fourteen, and the towel stays free.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈhʌndrəd fɔrˈtin ænd ðə ˈtaʊəl steɪz fri/
dialogue.zh: 二百一十四，毛巾照舊不收費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You just took eight dollars off.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju dʒʌst tʊk eɪt ˈdɑlərz ɔf/
dialogue.zh: 你一下就少了八塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My mistakes should not cost you.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ mɪˈsteɪks ʃʊd nɑt kɔst ju/
dialogue.zh: 我算錯的，不該你買單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Paper bills work, I have some on me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpeɪpər bɪlz wɜrk aɪ hæv sʌm ɑn mi/
dialogue.zh: 紙幣沒問題，我身上帶了一些。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small ones are easier for change.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɔl wʌnz ɑr ˈizɪɚ fər tʃeɪndʒ/
dialogue.zh: 小面額的找零方便些。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two hundreds and a twenty, here you go.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈhʌndrədz ænd ə ˈtwɛnti hɪr ju ɡoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 兩張一百加一張二十，給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, that covers it with six left.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ðæt ˈkʌvərz ɪt wɪθ sɪks lɛft/
dialogue.zh: 好，付完還多六塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keep the six, buy yourself lunch.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ðə sɪks baɪ jɔːrˈsɛlf lʌntʃ/
dialogue.zh: 那六塊你留著，去吃午飯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, let me count it back to you.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ lɛt mi kaʊnt ɪt bæk tə ju/
dialogue.zh: 不行，我還得如數找給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you write a receipt for this?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju raɪt ə rəˈsit fər ðɪs/
dialogue.zh: 這筆你會開收據嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I never print paper at my stall.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈnɛvər prɪnt ˈpeɪpər æt maɪ stɔl/
dialogue.zh: 我攤上從來不印單據。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then your nod is proof enough.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn jɔːr nɑd ɪz pruf ɪˈnʌf/
dialogue.zh: 那你點個頭就算憑證了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are a fair buyer, thank you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɑr ə fɛr ˈbaɪər θæŋk ju/
dialogue.zh: 你是痛快客人，謝謝你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I write my name on the bag?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ raɪt maɪ neɪm ɑn ðə bæɡ/
dialogue.zh: 我能在袋子上寫我名字嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Why mark your bags with a name?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ mɑrk jɔːr bæɡz wɪθ ə neɪm/
dialogue.zh: 幹嘛要在袋子上寫名字？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My son carries anything with a name.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ sʌn ˈkæriz ˈɛniˌθɪŋ wɪθ ə neɪm/
dialogue.zh: 我兒子一見有名字的就要搬。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then write it big, he will help you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn raɪt ɪt bɪɡ hi wɪl hɛlp ju/
dialogue.zh: 那就寫大點，他會幫你的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Was the table next to you busy?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌz ðə ˈteɪbəl nɛkst tə ju ˈbɪzi/
dialogue.zh: 你隔壁那攤今天忙嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Busy all morning, they sold out early.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɪzi ɔl ˈmɔrnɪŋ ðeɪ soʊld aʊt ˈɜrli/
dialogue.zh: 一上午都忙，早早賣光了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you ever sell out like that?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju ˈɛvər sɛl aʊt laɪk ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 你會不會也賣到精光？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not yet, my best pieces are stubborn.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt jɛt maɪ bɛst ˈpisɪz ɑr ˈstʌbərn/
dialogue.zh: 還沒，我捨不得出手最好的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have coffee in that thermos?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju hæv ˈkɔfi ɪn ðæt ˈθɜrməs/
dialogue.zh: 你那保溫壺裡裝的是咖啡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two cups left, and they are yours.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu kʌps lɛft ænd ðeɪ ɑr jɔrz/
dialogue.zh: 還剩兩杯，都給你喝。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You are sharing your own coffee?
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɑr ˈʃɛrɪŋ jɔːr oʊn ˈkɔfi/
dialogue.zh: 你自己的咖啡也分給我？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sharing keeps the market friendly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʃɛrɪŋ kips ðə ˈmɑrkɪt ˈfrɛndli/
dialogue.zh: 分著喝，市場才有人情味。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where did you learn to talk to buyers?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr dɪd ju lɜrn tə tɔk tə ˈbaɪərz/
dialogue.zh: 你這套待客的本事哪兒學的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My mother ran a stall for thirty years.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈmʌðər ræn ə stɔl fər ˈθɜrti jɪrz/
dialogue.zh: 我媽擺了三十年攤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What did she always tell you?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt dɪd ʃi ˈɔlˌweɪz tɛl ju/
dialogue.zh: 她以前總叮嚀你什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let the item choose its own person.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ði ˈaɪtəm tʃuz ɪts oʊn ˈpɜrsən/
dialogue.zh: 讓物件自己去挑它的主人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That sounds wise and a little poetic.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt aʊndz waɪz ænd ə ˈlɪtəl poʊˈɛtɪk/
dialogue.zh: 這話又聰明又有點詩意。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She never called it business, only luck.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi ˈnɛvər kɔld ɪt ˈbɪznɪs ˈoʊnli lʌk/
dialogue.zh: 她從不說做生意，只說是運氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you packing up for today?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ju ˈpækɪŋ ʌp fər təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 你今天就收攤了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soon, the vans start coming at five.
dialogue.phonetic: /sun ðə vænz stɑrt ˈkʌmɪŋ æt faɪv/
dialogue.zh: 快了，五點貨車就來拉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do prices change near closing time?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ˈpraɪsɪz tʃeɪndʒ nɪr ˈkloʊzɪŋ taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 快收攤時價格會變嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anything left must ride home with me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛniˌθɪŋ lɛft mʌst raɪd hoʊm wɪθ mi/
dialogue.zh: 沒賣掉的還得跟我回家。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So the last hour is the cheap one.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðə læst ˈaʊər ɪz ðə tʃip wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 所以最後一小時最便宜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart buyers wait and wander late.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑrt ˈbaɪərz weɪt ænd ˈwɑndər leɪt/
dialogue.zh: 會買的人都撐到最後才逛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is left on your table now?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪz lɛft ɑn jɔːr ˈteɪbəl naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 你攤上現在還剩什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two mismatched cups and a rusty tray.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˌmɪsˈmætʃt kʌps ænd ə ˈrʌstri treɪ/
dialogue.zh: 兩個不成對的杯子和一隻生鏽托盤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Honestly, my kitchen wall wants a tray.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɑnəstli maɪ ˈkɪtʃɪn wɔl wɑntz ə treɪ/
dialogue.zh: 說真的，我廚房牆上正缺隻托盤。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then take all three for one dollar.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn teɪk ɔl θri fər wʌn ˈdɑlər/
dialogue.zh: 那三樣你一塊錢全端走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you serious about the dollar?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ju ˈsɪriəs əˈbaʊt ðə ˈdɑlər/
dialogue.zh: 你說一塊錢，是認真的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Completely, my truck is already full.
dialogue.phonetic: /kəmˈplitli maɪ trʌk ɪz ɔlˈrɛdi fʊl/
dialogue.zh: 真的，我那車早塞滿了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you bring these back next week?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju brɪŋ ðiz bæk nɛkst wik/
dialogue.zh: 下週你會把這些再擺出來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, what rides home stays home.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ wɑt raɪdz hoʊm steɪz hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 不會，搬回去的就留家裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I take your leftovers happily.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ teɪk jɔːr ˈlɛftˌoʊvərz ˈhæpəli/
dialogue.zh: 那我高高興興接手你的尾貨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Leftovers are the best part of Sunday.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɛftˌoʊvərz ɑr ðə bɛst pɑrt ʌv ˈsʌnˌdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 這些尾貨才是週日的重頭戲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I help you fold this cloth?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ hɛlp ju foʊld ðɪs klɔθ/
dialogue.zh: 我幫你疊這塊布好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold one corner, now lift with me.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld wʌn ˈkɔrnər naʊ lɪft wɪθ mi/
dialogue.zh: 你捏住一角，然後跟我抬。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your crates stack really neatly.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔːr kreɪts stæk ˈrɪli ˈnitli/
dialogue.zh: 你的箱子碼得真整齊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A messy stall loses customers fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈmɛsi stɔl ˈlʊzɪz ˈkʌstəmərz fæst/
dialogue.zh: 攤子一亂，客人走得快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the market give you a booth number?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə ˈmɑrkɪt ɡɪv ju ə buð ˈnʌmbər/
dialogue.zh: 市場會給你攤位編號嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine is eleven, right by the fountain.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn ɪz ɪˈlɛvən raɪt baɪ ðə ˈfaʊntən/
dialogue.zh: 我的是十一號，就在噴泉邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it, eleven right beside the fountain.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt ɪˈlɛvən raɪt bɪˈsaɪd ðə ˈfaʊntən/
dialogue.zh: 記下了，噴泉旁邊的十一號攤。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Come early, good things go fast there.
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊm ˈɜrli ɡʊd θɪŋz ɡoʊ fæst ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 早點來，那兒好東西沒得快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I bring cash or a card?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ brɪŋ kæʃ ɔr ə kɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 下次我帶現金還是帶卡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cash, and coins for the coffee cart.
dialogue.phonetic: /kæʃ ænd kɔɪnz fər ðə ˈkɔfi kɑrt/
dialogue.zh: 現金，再帶硬幣去買咖啡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did I hear vendors singing earlier?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd aɪ hɪr ˈvɛndərz ˈsɪŋɪŋ ˈɜrliər/
dialogue.zh: 我剛才是不是聽見有人唱歌？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Old George sings while he folds tables.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊld ˈdʒɔrdʒ sɪŋz waɪl hi foʊldz ˈteɪbəlz/
dialogue.zh: 老喬治收桌子時愛唱兩句。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Singing makes packing look easy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪŋɪŋ meɪks ˈpækɪŋ lʊk ˈizi/
dialogue.zh: 唱著歌，收拾看著就輕鬆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try it, most of us hum all afternoon.
dialogue.phonetic: /traɪ ɪt moʊst ʌv ʌs hʌm ɔl ˌæftərˈnun/
dialogue.zh: 你也來，我們一下午都在哼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is my pile too heavy for one trip?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz maɪ paɪl tu ˈhɛvi fər wʌn trɪp/
dialogue.zh: 我這堆一趟搬得完嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take the crate cart, park by my table.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ðə kreɪt kɑrt pɑrk baɪ maɪ ˈteɪbəl/
dialogue.zh: 推那台箱子車來，停我桌邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I return this cart?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr du aɪ rɪˈtɜrn ðɪs kɑrt/
dialogue.zh: 這推車我歸還到哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Leave it with the gate man, he keeps it.
dialogue.phonetic: /liv ɪt wɪð ðə ɡeɪt mæn hi kips ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 交給守門大叔，他會收好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You treated me like an old friend.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ˈtritɪd mi laɪk ən oʊld frɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 你待我像老朋友一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are one now, a buyer turned friend.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɑr wʌn naʊ ə ˈbaɪər tɜrnd frɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 現在你就是了，買主變朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So may I come back another Sunday?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ meɪ aɪ kʌm bæk əˈnʌðər ˈsʌnˌdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 那我可以下個週日再來逛嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please do, my new boxes arrive Sunday.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz du maɪ nju ˈbɑksɪz əˈraɪv ˈsʌnˌdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 一定要來，我週日到新貨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I hear the inkwell story again?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ hɪr ði ˈɪŋkˌwɛl ˈstɔri əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 那個墨水瓶的故事我還能再聽嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring coffee and I will tell you all.
dialogue.phonetic: /brɪŋ ˈkɔfi ænd aɪ wɪl tɛl ju ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 你帶咖啡來，我全說給你聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good thing I stayed so late today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd θɪŋ aɪ steɪd soʊ leɪt təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 幸好我今天留到了這麼晚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Late is fine, the best finds hide.
dialogue.phonetic: /leɪt ɪz faɪn ðə bɛst faɪndz haɪd/
dialogue.zh: 晚沒關係，好貨都藏得深。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My arms are full but my heart is light.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ɑrmz ɑr fʊl bʌt maɪ hɑrt ɪz laɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我兩手抱滿，心裡卻輕鬆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is why we love this market.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz waɪ wi lʌv ðɪs ˈmɑrkɪt/
dialogue.zh: 這就是我們愛這市場的理由。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I help those ladies with their plates?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ hɛlp ðoʊz ˈleɪdiz wɪð ðɛr pleɪts/
dialogue.zh: 要幫那兩位女士端盤子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, walk slowly, the ground is uneven.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wɔk ˈsloʊli ðə ɡraʊnd ɪz ʌnˈivən/
dialogue.zh: 好啊，慢些走，地面不平。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See you next Sunday, Rosa.
dialogue.phonetic: /si ju nɛkst ˈsʌnˌdeɪ ˈroʊzə/
dialogue.zh: 下個週日見，羅莎。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring a bag with room, you will need it.
dialogue.phonetic: /brɪŋ ə bæɡ wɪð rum ju wɪl nid ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 帶個寬鬆點的袋子，你會需要的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am already planning my route.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æm ɔlˈrɛdi ˈplænɪŋ maɪ rut/
dialogue.zh: 我已經在盤算路線了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take the north gate, parking is free there.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ðə nɔrθ ɡeɪt ˈpɑrkɪŋ ɪz fri ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 走北門吧，那邊停車免費。
